mapper.select: SELECT l.*, a.area_name, a.area_code, a.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name FROM wm_storage_location l LEFT JOIN wm_storage_area a ON l.area_id = a.area_id AND a.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse w ON a.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id AND w.del_flag = '0' ${ew.customSqlSegment}

SELECT l.*, a.area_name, a.area_code, a.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name FROM wm_storage_location l LEFT JOIN wm_storage_area a ON l.area_id = a.area_id AND a.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse w ON a.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id AND w.del_flag = '0' ${ew.customSqlSegment}
SELECT location_id, location_code, location_name, area_id, location_type, enable_flag, status, occupancy_rate FROM wm_storage_location WHERE del_flag = '0' ORDER BY area_id, location_id

SELECT location_id, location_code, location_name, area_id, pos_x, pos_y, pos_z, width, height, location_depth, rotation_x, rotation_y, rotation_z, color_empty, color_occupied, color_locked, color_warning, opacity, show_border, border_color, border_width, show_label, label_position, label_size, frozen_flag, enable_flag, rack_id, layer, col, row_num, status, occupancy_rate FROM wm_storage_location WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY area_id, location_id
